content: Jesús-gannar-durgusad
Obunnoged-iba-nasgu, María-Magdalena, Santiago-e-nan-María, degi, Salomé, gwallu-wawa-nuegan baksamalad, adi, Jesús-muigi eonamalagar.
A-omegan gebe-itoged-iba-nagudedgi, wakudaryalaba, gebe dad-nakwialidgi, neg-uanse nadmalad.
Igarba na muchub-muchub sunmaknadapmalad: “¿Doa wede anmarga akwa-dummad-neg-uan-yawagakgi-siid oniroe?”
Ar akwade, bela-bela dungued. Ar neg-uan-mosmargu, dakarmalad, akwa-dummad-neg-uan-yawagakgi-siidi bato onirar sii.
Omegan neg-uan-yaba-dogdemargu, dakarmalad, Jesús-mai-gusad-argan-nuedsik sapin-gwensak mola-sibu-suid-yoi sii. Deyob dakarmargu, omegan gwakidmalad.
Sapingwa omeganga sogded: —Mer be dobgumar. Ar bemar Jesús-Nazaretʼgined, nakrusgi-biokles-gusad amidanimalad. Wegi bar maisulid, bato gannar durgusad. Bia e-mui-mesisgusmalad-e-gannar be dakmala.
Ar bemar e-sapinganga, degi, Pedroʼga sognamar: ‘Jesús bemar-idu Galileaʼse nadye.’ Igi bemarga sogsagusa, agi bemar dakoed.
Omegan dobedba wawanmakgwichi neg-uangi wakitemalad. Ar nue-dobe-itomarsoggu, dulemarga gwen ibmar sogsasurmalad.
Jesús, María-Magdalenaʼse magarosad
[Jesús gebe-itoged-iba-naguded-wakudaryalaba-durgusgua, gebesaila María-Magdalenaʼse na sanar magarosad. A-omegi, Jesús nia-walagugle (7) onosgusad.
A-ome nadgua, geb dulemar-Jesúsʼba-gudigusmalad owisosad. Amardi bukib-binsabukwad, degi, bobukmarbalid.
Ar amar, Jesús dula-gudiiye itoarmargu, degi, María-Magdalena daksaye itoarmarbargu, bengusmalad.
Jesús, e-sapingan-warbogwadse magarosad
A-sorba, Jesús na e-sapingan-warbo-sapurba-nadapidse dule-baidyob magarosad.
Amar-warbogwad, gannar Jerusalén-neggweburse nonimalad, geb sapingan-baigan owisosmalad. Ar sapingan-warbogwad-ibmar-sognonikid, sapingan-baigandi bengusmarbalid.
Jesús, e-sapingan-bur-dummaganga igar-uksad

Geb napidgine, Jesús na e-sapingan-ambe-gakagwensakad-mas-gunbukwadse (11) na sanar magarosad. Jesús, e-sapingan amba egi benmarsoggu, degi, dulemar-gannar-e-durgusad-daksamalad-ega-sogsad benmarbarsoggu, na e-sapinganga binnasur ibmar sogsagussunnad.
Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: “Bela dulemar-we-napneggi-bukmaladse be namar, bela amarga Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi be sunmaknamar.
”Ar dule-angi-bensulid, degi, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaked, abonolegoed. ”Ar dule-angi-benguerdi, na e-san-burba degi-odurdakle-sii sadeguoed.
”Dulemar-angi-bensurmalad, we-ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad imakoed:
Jesús nibnegse nakwided
Bab-Jesús e-sapinganga ibmar-sogsad-sorba, Bab-Dummad, Jesús nibnegse sesad. Geb Bab-Dummad-argan-nuedsik sigidapid.

Jesús-sapingan nadmargu, bela neggwebur-iliba Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmakdemalad. Bab-Jesús nue amar-bendaksad, degi, ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad-imakdemaladba Bab-Jesús oyosad, e-sapingan e-Gayaburba-napiragwadgi sunmakdimarye.] Be itomargua.
